name: denubis-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for Python/SQL/LaTeX development workflows - customized for academic research

plugins.name: denubis-00-getting-started
plugins.description: Getting started guide and onboarding for denubis-plugins

plugins.name: denubis-plan-and-execute
plugins.description: Design, implementation, debugging, verification, architecture, and Git lifecycle procedures for Claude Code.

plugins.name: denubis-basic-agents
plugins.description: Core agents for general-purpose tasks with Python/academic domain variants. Other plugins expect this to exist.

plugins.name: denubis-research-agents
plugins.description: Agents for codebase investigation and internet research.

plugins.name: denubis-extending-agents
plugins.description: Authoring and maintaining agent extensions for Claude Code and Codex: plugins, agents, skills, directives, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md files, marketplaces, and upstream sync

plugins.name: denubis-git-commit
plugins.description: Git commit skill for Claude Code. Handles /commit as a proper skill.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-code-quality-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse guard for concrete browser-test and schema-migration violations.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-gh-fork-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that blocks gh CLI commands targeting any repo other than the user's fork. Auto-discovered by the pretooluse-bash dispatcher.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-pretooluse-dispatcher
plugins.description: PreToolUse:Bash dispatcher with auto-discovery from marketplace plugins and drop directory. Runs hooks sequentially and merges outputs.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-branch-bg
plugins.description: SessionStart hook plus a tmux pane-title strip: every pane shows [person][repo][branch][session] as coloured blocks with black-or-white text, colours assigned through a per-machine registry, the field behind text a near-black shade of the repo colour (tmux pane and OSC 11).

plugins.name: denubis-academic
plugins.description: Scholarly workflow for Claude Code: academic writing, manuscript review, literature scouting, annotated bibliographies, and Zotero-managed sources rendered to page-keyed Markdown.

plugins.name: denubis-crash-recovery
plugins.description: Identify and resume Claude Code sessions that ended abnormally; classifies live/crashed/concluded sessions deterministically and renders ~/llm-resume.md.

plugins.name: denubis-token-estimator
plugins.description: Measure AI token/word usage from Claude Code and Codex logs for AI-use disclosures. Output tokens are origin-deduplicated and split between root threads and subagent fan-out; human input words exclude injected records and named machine markers and are split into own authorship and pasted text. Report per project, by month or exact time window. WIP — independent audit pending.

plugins.name: denubis-external-agents
plugins.description: Consult other agent sessions without merging their authority into the caller. Run Codex peer reviews, launch a human-triggered Fable consultation with an explicit tool-surface check, or supervise a Codex pane. Review findings require resolvable provenance. WIP.

plugins.name: denubis-project-notes
plugins.description: Task-entry inspection and human-approved, evidence-linked creation or maintenance of project notes and ADRs, with conditional prior-chat recovery.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-instruction-budget
plugins.description: SessionStart alarm for oversized global and project instruction chains in Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: denubis-hook-quiet-agents
plugins.description: Takes a teammate's idle notice once its report arrived, mutes repeated agent notices, frames agent-started turns, shows idle agents, asks the model at a turn's end to stop idle or finished agents, and adds /tidy to stop them

plugins.name: denubis-hook-agent-notice-log
plugins.description: Logs the first 300 characters of every submitted prompt and every inbound delivery, with its origin, to a JSONL file, changing nothing
